status: Volumetric gore v12 technically delivered; human visual/play acceptance pending

features.remains: Closed beveled meshes reuse existing native painted body parts, tumble in three axes, and persist with actual volume after supported settlement. No chunk gameplay colliders.
features.ownership: Normal deaths keep intact persistent corpses with zero severed parts. Authoritative overkill and postmortem rupture own one breakup; duplicate damage cannot add a second kill or burst.
features.blood: Six weapon-specific blood counts, cone, speed and size profiles; bounded blood pools and splashes. Siege breakup radiates from the authoritative explosion position.
features.support: Swept conservative sphere prevents wall tunneling; actual convex volume and bearing contacts govern floor/stair/edge settlement. Unsupported pieces fall and expire rather than snapping.
features.preserved: All nine authored scenes, Main, enemy AI/health, weapons, HUD, lighting, art PNGs, 63 audio cues and audio files remain unchanged from v11b.

performance.scope: Controlled native Main diagnostics on current machine; not sustained human performance acceptance or an unchanged-baseline claim.
performance.finding: Largest observed ~0.75s wall outlier was Retry world rebuild before combat; no speculative production optimization applied.

known_limits: Remains are coarse beveled extrusions of existing painted anatomy, not bespoke sculpted anatomical models.
Conservative cosmetic support queries can reject narrow ledges; unsupported pieces expire after their bounded lifetime.
Controlled screenshots and automated campaign/capture checks do not establish human movement comfort, pacing, visual acceptance or matched-level listening approval.
Pickup ambush expansion and complete directional creature animation remain later work.
Original music for every current and future level remains deferred, using present tracks as references.
